claims.claim: Intersect requests 25,400,000 ADA for its core operating model covering governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, release coordination, and critical unowned processes from June 2026 to June 2027.

The proposed budget is allocated as 6,000,000 ADA for operations and ecosystem coordination, 18,800,000 ADA for technical stewardship and incident response, and 600,000 ADA for management of critical processes.
Intersect states that its overall ask has been reduced from $7.875M last year to $6.35M while preserving the functions most critical to Cardano continuity and maturity.
Intersect states it has coordinated two network upgrades, is preparing for a third, and led ecosystem coordination during the November 2025 chain partition incident.
The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and therefore advanced to on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Independent audits and assurance for the proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible review of deliverables, controls, spend validation, and milestone evidence.
Intersect discloses that it and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA in prior Cardano Treasury funding through three listed governance actions in the past 24 months.

Intersect will use a Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, one Project-Specific Smart Contract, five admin roles, three leadership roles, and a six-entity external Oversight Committee.
The proposal states that the TRSC and PSSC cannot be staked with an SPO, are delegated to the auto-abstain predefined DRep, and can be tracked through a public dashboard and on-chain records.

summary: The document requests 25,400,000 ADA for Intersect’s June 2026 to June 2027 operating, governance coordination, and technical stewardship functions, with budget-package detail, prior-funding disclosure, external references for voting and smart-contract oversight, and several operational claims asserted by the proposer.
